== Remove the X Windows Package Group
----
To ensure the X Windows package group is removed, run the following command:
$ rpm -qi xorg-x11-server-common
The output should be:
package xorg-x11-server-common is not installed
      Is it the case that the X Windows package group or xorg-x11-server-common has not be removed?
----

discussion:
## Remove the X Windows Package Group

By removing the xorg-x11-server-common package, the system no longer has X Windows
installed. If X Windows is not installed then the system cannot boot into graphical user mode.
This prevents the system from being accidentally or maliciously booted into a `graphical.target`
mode. To do so, run the following command:

```
$ sudo apt_get groupremove "X Window System"
```

        
```
$ sudo apt_get remove xorg-x11-server-common
```

**Rationale:**

Unnecessary service packages must not be installed to decrease the attack surface of the system. X windows has a long history of security
vulnerabilities and should not be installed unless approved and documented.

steps.name: Remove the X Windows Package Group
steps.shell:
# CAUTION: This remediation script will remove xserver-common
# from the system, and may remove any packages
# that depend on xserver-common. Execute this
# remediation AFTER testing on a non-production
# system!


# check wether the package is virtual: if not, remove it.
# if the package is virtual, iterate on providers
#  if a provider is installed, remove it
is_virtual=`apt-cache showpkg "xserver-common" | grep -Pzc 'Versions: \n\n'`
if [ $is_virtual = 1 ]; then
    rprovides_line=`apt-cache showpkg "xserver-common" | grep -n 'Reverse Provides:' | cut -f1 -d:`
    pkglist=`apt-cache showpkg "xserver-common" | tail -n +$(($rprovides_line + 1)) | cut -f1 -d' '`
    for package in $pkglist; do
        not_installed=`apt-cache policy $package | grep -c 'Installed: (none)'`
	if [ $not_installed = 0 ]; then
	    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 remove -y $package
	fi
    done
else
    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=60 remove -y "xserver-common"
fi
